items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "Lambert, Hendricks, and Ross had worked for Lou for at least five years. So we knew him. Knew him very well, as a matter of fact. He’s a wonderful man."

ctx.x: One of the places that you performed during that time was at the Trident?

Yes. That was a restaurant run – managed by a guy named Lou Ganapoler, who had managed the Village Vanguard for 25 years. Lambert, Hendricks, and Ross had worked for Lou for at least five years. So we knew him. Knew him very well, as a matter of fact. He’s a wonderful man. Lou Ganapoler is one of the great men of this business. He’s not only a good manager of the club, but he loves the art, and he was a cultured man himself. He’s an actor and a writer. He’s the one that got the best performance out of Miles Davis…
